subject.title: fix(gateway): cap pendingFinalDelivery retries and prevent delivery wedge

question: After the deterministic regression wait is fixed, should exhausted pending-final payloads be permanently discarded after ten accepted restart-recovery attempts?
rationale: The implementation can eliminate the infinite wedge, but the default threshold and irreversible retention-versus-delivery tradeoff are product and operator-recovery policy that code review cannot safely choose.

options.title: Accept bounded retirement
options.body: Merge the ten-attempt backoff policy after fixing the test and accept permanent clearing when attempts are exhausted.

options.title: Retain recoverable dead letters
options.body: Store exhausted payloads in an operator-visible canonical owner before clearing active session recovery state.

options.title: Reject automatic retirement
options.body: Do not land permanent clearing and pursue another anti-wedge mechanism that preserves the payload indefinitely.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded retirement
recommendation.body: Merge the ten-attempt backoff policy after fixing the test and accept permanent clearing when attempts are exhausted.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the restart-recovery path and made the most recent lifecycle integration change in the same module.
